item.title: Negotiate Like the FBI 💬 • Use: "I achieved X% by Y in Z timeframe." • Mirror their words to build rapport. • Label their emotions to show understanding. • Ask calibrated questions: "How can we move forward?" • Always be ready to walk away for better leverage.
